scope.limits: Birth/Create through terminal TFA anchor at provider-price peak +3 seconds; this is token-history plus one selected pool, not all venues, market trades, or lifetime ATH scope.

selection_rule: Include exactly target CreateEvent POST, all 96 bound target curve TradeEvent POSTs, and all 11 selected-pool event PRE/POST states. Exclude every conditional curve PRE interval from observed maxima; retain all 96 separately as diagnostics below.

historical_supply.per_mark_supply_source: instruction-ordered historical mint/burn ledger in frozen supply certificate

excluded_pre_interval_diagnostics.reason: The transaction-level curve lamport delta for one two-TradeEvent transaction only reconciles in aggregate, not per event. Curve PRE intervals also depend on conditional SDK-model equations; 24-byte buy wires omit the dated track_volume bool and appended account roles are unresolved.

limits: Pump.fun 24-byte buy/buy_exact_sol_in payloads omit the dated SDK1.31 track_volume argument; no false default applied. The 25-byte forms are validated only when that byte is 0 or 1.
55 trailing curve instruction account slots are preserved but their roles are not identified from the dated SDK1.31 IDL.

The curve PDA lamport delta is only a whole-transaction observation: 92/94 single-trade transactions match the signed event amount, two do not; one transaction contains two target trade calls and only its grouped signed sum matches. No per-instruction lamport delta is exposed. Parent-scoped user-to-curve System transfers independently match all 60 buy inputs. Sell user output is not inferred from the curve PDA delta.

Some created token accounts have no preTokenBalances row. The audit does not infer zero; it binds the event token amount to the exact ordered Token-2022 transfer instruction and records the missing-balance limitation where applicable.
PumpSwap pool account is a current snapshot; its required decoded fields identify immutable pool/vault/mint roles, but 40 trailing account bytes remain uninterpreted.
Historical PumpSwap event layout is pinned to the cached 2026-02-17 IDL. No SDK1.31 account or event shape is projected onto other dates beyond this dated source.
